recommendations.name: DRS-OSS (drs-llm)
recommendations.description: The closest open-source analogue to Meta's DRS: a fine-tuned Llama 3.1 8B diff risk classifier with a FastAPI gateway, web dashboard and optional GitHub App, though it needs a GPU (the paper targets a 32 GB V100 with 4-bit quantization).

recommendations.name: DRS-OSS replication package (jit-dp-llm)
recommendations.description: The fine-tuning scripts from the same authors, which you can use to train the risk model on your own repository's history instead of relying on the pretrained one.

recommendations.name: gitrisky
recommendations.description: A lightweight MIT-licensed Python CLI that trains on your repo's commit history and gives each commit a 0 to 1 bug-risk score from git metadata, a far simpler non-LLM option, though I could not confirm how recently it was maintained.
